## Preparing the exam

**Template**: <https://github.com/fs-ise/exam-template>

```bash
cd ~/Nextcloud/teaching/exams/YYYY_SEM
uvx copier copy gh:fs-ise/exam-template path_to_new-exam
cd path_to_new-exam
make setup
make exams
```

- Exam dates: <pruefungsorganisation@fs.de>
- View examination dates in TimeEdit: Log in to TimeEdit as a staff member. Then either open **All Room Bookings** or use the **Examination Schedule** (set the date in the header and search for the relevant exam).
- Submit the exam as a PDF document at least two weeks before the examination date.
- Include sufficient space for students to provide their answers.
- Arrange a review by colleagues for large courses (e.g., Introduction to Programming); prefer sequential over parallel feedback.

::: {.callout-important title="Checklist"}
- Use a Git repository during development. Once the exam is finalized and archived, remove the `.git` directory.
- Consider `Nextcloud/teaching/exams/materials/*` for new tasks/ideas.
- Do not reuse old exams.
  Students have access to a large Dropbox folder containing previous exams.
- Use a sandboxed AI to check for errors and potential misunderstandings.

See `Nextcloud/exams/checklist.md` for additional items.
:::

## Grading

- Exato: Link shared by the Examination Office.
- Grading deadline: Three weeks (including the Christmas period), interpreted as 15 working days.
- Grading can be completed digitally or on paper.
- Group work graded in Canvas: Send an email to <pruefungsorganisation@fs.de>, asking the Examination Office to run the grade transfer.
- Check the grade distribution: [Faculty manual](https://nc-2272638881871040784.nextcloud-ionos.com/index.php/apps/files/files/1728329?dir=/management/compliance&openfile=true){target=_blank}.

## Preparing the exam

**Creating a new exam**

- Copy `template_for_copying.tex` to the archive and rename it; start with `_with_solution.tex`.
- Update the header (semester).
- Check permitted aids (**student summaries**).
- Create exam questions (referring to `collection_exam_questions_and_solutions.tex`).
- Check whether all the contents were covered in the lecture (if sessions were skipped, the contents cannot be covered in the exam).
- Check specific notes in the `README.md` of the respective exam repository.
- Add grading notes, e.g., "Grading: deduct 0.5 points for each missing state or transition."
- Count points within individual tasks.
- Count points overall.
- Check for missing items (A, B, D).
- Spellcheck.
- Copy the template and remove the solutions (including multiple-choice checks); update the header.
- Update `collection_exam_questions_and_solutions.tex`.
- When the exams are not printed immediately, add a reminder to include the student summaries (if applicable).

**Print**

- Print exams.
- Add student summaries (if applicable).

## Preparing materials

- Examination documents received by mail.
- Envelope includes:
  - Important documents for centrally organized examinations
  - Checklist for conducting written examinations
  - Name labels
  - Examination protocol
  - Incident log for the examination
  - Name notices
  - Signs stating "Please do not disturb — examination in progress"
  - Attendance list/paper check
  - Checklist "Examination Process Flow"
  - Supervision guidelines
  - Information sheet on withdrawing from an exam for health reasons
  - Information on participants on maternity leave, additional examination participants ("Scheinteilnehmende"), etc.
- Professor provides the exam sheets (and summaries, if applicable).

## Examination day

- Examination dates are announced by email by the Examination Office.
- Materials are provided by the professor.
- The secretariat will receive further important information by email, for example, regarding retrospective identity verification after examinations ("Nachträgliche Identitätsfeststellung").

::: callout-important
- Cases of cheating (academic misconduct/Unterschleif): Immediately enter the incident into FlexNow and send the exam to the Examination Office (do not grade it).
- Missed examinations (Versäumnisklausuren): Immediately enter the absence into FlexNow and archive the examination papers for one year in the filing cabinet.
- Send the exam sheets, protocols (attendance lists), and two blank exam copies to the Examination Office immediately after the examinations are completed.
- Blank exam copies for missed examinations (Versäumnis-Klausur): Archive for one semester.
:::

## Grading

- Create a reminder for the deadline: approximately September 15 (summer semester) or March 24 (winter semester). Grade early because colleagues may be on vacation before the deadline (and unavailable to review failed exams).
- Add bonus points, if any, **only if the exam has been passed**. Otherwise, record the bonus points and add a note stating "cannot be credited".
- Do not dispose of blank exam copies.
- Use the [grading scripts](https://github.com/fs-ise/handbook/tree/main/src/grading){target="_blank"} to assign grades and prepare the FlexNow import.
- Have failed exams reviewed by a second professor.

## Entering grades (in FlexNow)

::: callout-note
Certificates can be issued if exams are not (yet) available in FlexNow (see [process](certificates.html)).
:::

- [Login: FlexNow](https://fn2web.zuv.uni-bamberg.de/FN2AUTH/FN2AuthServlet?op=Login){target="_blank"} – Department Module – Examination Participants / Centrally Organized / Select Course / Load Participants.
- Form for editing individual participants: Enter grades (points do not need to be entered), save, and continue.
- Alternatively, use CSV: Export (UTF-8), add grades/points via VLOOKUP, and import (CSV format: semicolon-separated, no quotation marks).
- In the upper section: Load Participants, Print, Export by Course Semester:
  "Permanently release and record grades" ([Nextcloud]({{< var nextcloud.grades >}}){target="_blank"}). After activation, changes can only be made through the Examination Office (wiai.pruefungen@uni-bamberg.de).
- Only store grades as PDF (not as CSV)?
- Sort the corrected examination papers according to the order in the PDF.
- Return corrected examination papers to the Examination Office (via internal mail) in a secure box or envelope.

Project:

- Decentralized examination
- "Add participants"
- Enter grades
- Release grades
- Save grades as PDF in Nextcloud (delete the Excel file if applicable)

::: callout-note
If grades cannot be entered, contact the FlexNow team via email: [flexnow@uni-bamberg.de](mailto:flexnow@uni-bamberg.de).
:::

## ERASMUS students

For ERASMUS students, the FlexNow team must assign students to modules. Use the following email template:

```Markdown
Betreff: Anlage eines Moduls für ERASMUS Studierende

Liebe Kolleginnen und Kollegen des FlexNow-Teams,

Darf ich Sie bitten, in FlexNow das nachstehende Modul für die unten genannten ERASMUS-Studierenden anzulegen:

* **Modulhandbuch:** Modulhandbuch Bachelor Wirtschaftsinformatik – Studienbeginn ab dem WS 2024/2025
* **Modultitel:** LV\_721\_114387\_1\_81\_1 – Digital-Work-Projekt-B: Bachelorprojekt aus der Fächergruppe Wirtschaftsinformatik (Wagner)

Für folgende Studierende:

* Student name (student ID)
* Student name (student ID)
* Student name (student ID)

Vielen Dank im Voraus!

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Gerit Wagner
```

Once students can be selected, double-check the number of ECTS before submitting grades.
